about: Hand-checked corrections applied by `pipeline build` (see pipeline/corrections.py). The 2026-09-23 entries were found by re-reading the live menu during that day's price check; all but Tavern on Jane and Jimbo's Hamburger Palace were confirmed by two independent checks. Every 2026-09-24 entry was confirmed by two independent checks; where the restaurant's own current menu page can be scraped, the fix is a menu-URL override in pipeline/data/menu_urls.json instead (re-scraped on the next run). The 2026-09-25 entries come from the review of each restaurant's one published burger (its highest-priced beef burger): Boeuf & Bun and the two Carnegie Diners were re-read on their own current menu pages; the Grillify-NYC delivery prices could not be confirmed; and the Grubhub/Seamless entries withhold pages whose cached scrape shows only the Best Sellers / recently ordered items (the burger section never loaded). Remove one of those once a full menu for the restaurant has been scraped. A second 2026-09-25 batch records the errors two independent checks agreed on in that review: closed restaurants (Abbey Tavern, Bell Book & Candle, Kelly's Tavern) and a page for another restaurant (True Burger at JFK) are withheld, and so are pages whose only prices are years old or marked up; a missed or mispriced top burger is corrected from the page named in source_url.
